messages:
Maya (Design): Quick sanity check — new Usage table header and tag chips. I'm worried the chip text (gray-400 on gray-800) is borderline for AA. Also the row focus ring feels very faint when high-contrast mode is on. Screenshot attached: /files/usage-chips.png
Priya (A11y): Can you paste the hex values? Gray-400 → #9AA0A6 on #101214? If so, AA fails for small text. For UI chips aim for a contrast ratio >= 3:1. Also add a visible focus outline for keyboard: 2px solid or use outline-offset.
Sam (Eng): @Priya I can try bumping the chip weight and adding a `box-shadow` focus for the row. Quick CSS patch:
```
.chip { color: #cbd5d1; }
.row:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.12); outline: none; }
```
Jordan (DevEx): For the chip text maybe change copy to shorter token so it wraps less — reduces perceived low contrast. E.g., 'GPU pool' -> 'Pool'.
Maya (Design): Good point. Also noticed the flyout menu loses keyboard focus when opening from kebab; focus goes to body. Repro: open kebab, press down, menu closes.
Sam (Eng): That's a bug — probable tabindex/role issue. I'll add `aria-expanded` and move focus to first menuitem on open. Quick aria suggestion: `<button aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="true">`
Priya (A11y): Also ensure menu has `role="menu"` and items `role="menuitem"` and `tabindex="-1"` + JS to manage focus. Screen reader will read the state.
Maya (Design): Can we keep the visual of the dotted focus ring but make it thicker? Users like subtle but visible.
Jordan (DevEx): What about a theme-aware focus: dark theme -> white 2px solid, light theme -> brand-600 2px solid.
Sam (Eng): I'll ship a small PR after lunch.
CI Bot: PR #4123 created by @sam — tests pass. Deployed to canary at 2025-06-20T16:12:00Z :rocket:
Maya (Design): Awesome — thanks! Let's do a quick screenreader run after canary. Anyone to volunteer? @Jordan?
Jordan (DevEx): I'll run VoiceOver and NVDA checks tomorrow morning. :+1:
Priya (A11y): I'll add these to the a11y regression set as an assert.
Maya (Design): Closing loop — adding note to tickets. Thanks all :heart:
